title: Claude Code Introduces Sonnet 5.5 With 1M Context
summary: Anthropic ships Claude Code v2.1.284 featuring native Claude Sonnet 5.5 with a 1M context window, alongside major releases from Astral uv and Model Context Protocol TypeScript SDK.
thesis: Agent workflows absorb expanded context limits.

items.name: claude-code
items.what: Terminal-based agentic coding tool integrating codebase understanding and git workflows.
items.whyDifferent: Adds native support for Claude Sonnet 5.5 featuring a 1M context window and updated API pricing.

items.name: uv
items.what: Extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust.
items.whyDifferent: Introduces lockfile reuse optimization when dependency declarations are semantically equivalent.

items.name: typescript-sdk
items.what: Official TypeScript SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients.
items.whyDifferent: Updates pagination for list calls to automatically traverse cursors until completion.

readThrough: Recent releases push expanded context windows and automated pagination into production tooling. Teams running agentic workflows gain deeper repository introspection without manual intervention, while python and protocol ecosystems tighten lockfile efficiency; teams should validate it before adoption.

social.linkedin: Anthropic has shipped Claude Code v2.1.284, introducing native support for Claude Sonnet 5.5 with a 1M context window. Simultaneously, Astral released uv 0.12.20 with advanced lockfile reuse, and Model Context Protocol rolled out TypeScript SDK v2.2.0 featuring automatic cursor pagination. These updates collectively enhance context handling and dependency management for engineering teams.
